snippet.title: 黑暗料理?! [ Dark Cuisine?! ] // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/970530/_/

这是一款你从未玩过的餐厅模拟游戏！高度自由的做菜玩法，创造和探索菜谱，昼夜系统结合了农场牧场的经营养成，顾客口味偏好多种多样，还有更多奇葩内容等你探索
- - -
This is a restaurant simulation game you have never played before! Highly free cooking gameplay, creating and exploring recipes, day and night system combined with farm and ranch management, diverse customer tastes and preferences, and more fantastic content waiting for you to explore.

Developed by
DoubleC Games

*not an official translation
